name: Rotary Districts 9560 JCU Accommodation Scholarship
summary: $4,000 for final-year JCU students from north Queensland or the NT postcodes who are in financial hardship.
key: $4,000 paid in one lump sum after census date of study period two.
who: Australian citizen or permanent resident in the final year of a degree (24 credit points or fewer left).
Full-time, with a GPA of at least 4.0.
Home address in Queensland postcodes 4630 to 4895 or NT postcodes 0800 to 0860, and in financial hardship.
catches: The 2026 round closed at midday on 29 May 2026. Check for the next round.

evidence.quote: $4,000 paid in one lump sum after census date of study period two
